title: Query executor: generated call -> safe scoped Ecto query (allowlist re-check, indexed full-text, audit, fail-closed)

epic.name: Context Retriever (entity-schema -> auto-generated agent tool surface)

priority_note: The security boundary of the epic: it turns a model tool-call into a DB query. Enhanced-review round 1 hardened it — execute-time allowlist re-check, a real indexed full-text path, tenant-context enforcement, audit logging, and fail-closed edges. Depends on 30.1 (schema + column allowlist) and 30.2 (generator metadata).

background.reference: GitHub issue #309 ('safe, scoped Ecto query, parameterized, tenant/role-scoped, paginated. No raw SQL from the model'). Review round 1: the articles full-text path (stored search_vector tsvector) exists ONLY on articles — stories/projects/epics have none, so full-text needs a new indexed column; and the entity allowlist must be re-validated at execute time (the raw /retrieve API bypasses generate-time checks).
background.includes: US-30.2 specs carry (entity, field, operation) metadata. This story executes a generated call against the entity's backing loopctl source with: execute-time allowlist re-validation, mandatory non-overridable tenant scoping (RLS context + explicit predicate), parameterization, capped pagination, indexed full-text, audit logging, and fail-closed handling of superadmin/stale-schema edges.

story.i_want_to: execute a generated tool call by building a parameterized Ecto query scoped to the caller's tenant, restricted to the entity's server-allowlisted filterable/searchable fields, over an INDEXED full-text column for search, with enforced pagination and an audit record
story.so_that: agents get governed structured-data access with no model SQL, no non-allowlisted column, no cross-tenant read, no unindexed-scan DoS, and a full audit trail

rationale: This is where model output touches the database, the highest-risk component. Re-validating the allowlist at execute time (not trusting generate-time), pinning every value as a param, forcing tenant context, using an indexed tsvector for search, and auditing each query is what makes 'let an LLM query our data' safe rather than an exfiltration/DoS surface.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.ContextRetriever.Executor.run/3 takes a scope (tenant_id + role), (entity, field, operation) metadata, and params, resolves the entity via the Registry, and RE-VALIDATES the field/operation against the entity's fields AND the server per-source column allowlist (US-30.1 AC-30.1.2) at EXECUTE time — a request naming a field not currently allowlisted/filterable/searchable is rejected, never executed (closes the raw-/retrieve bypass of generate-time checks).

Every query is tenant-scoped by BOTH mechanisms: the executor sets RLS tenant context (Repo.put_tenant_id / with_tenant) AND adds an explicit tenant_id predicate (defense-in-depth). No param can widen/override the tenant. Isolation is proven under the non-owner app role (RLS is ENABLE not FORCE).

No model-authored SQL: field names map from the validated allowlist to known column atoms (never String.to_atom on model input); values are always Ecto-pinned params (never interpolated). An injection payload in a filter value or a search query string is a literal, not SQL.

Full-text search uses an INDEXED path: a migration adds GIN-indexed generated tsvector column(s) to the phase-1 backing tables for their searchable text fields; search_<entity> runs websearch_to_tsquery against that column (parameterized), NOT an on-the-fly to_tsvector seq scan and NOT ILIKE. (If a source's searchable columns can't be indexed in v1, that entity's search tool is not generated.)

Pagination is enforced with a hard maximum page size (config) returning %{results, meta: %{total_count, limit, offset}}; no unbounded result set. Result shaping returns ONLY the entity's declared (allowlisted) fields — no undeclared/sensitive column leaks.

Every execution appends an audit record (reuse loopctl's audit/chain-of-custody infra) capturing tenant_id, key/subject, entity, field, operation, param digest, and row count — a model-driven query over business data is auditable.

Fail-closed edges: (a) a superadmin/no-tenant context on /retrieve is refused (no cross-tenant AdminRepo read); (b) a declared field whose backing column was renamed/dropped (stale entity def) returns a clean {:error, :stale_entity} — never a raw DB error that discloses schema internals.

test_cases.name: filter executes as a parameterized, tenant-scoped query (under app role)
preconditions: stories seeded under tenant and another tenant
run under SET LOCAL ROLE loopctl_app with tenant context
expected_results: only tenant's ready stories; other tenant's rows never appear; %{results, meta}; an audit record is written

test_cases.name: non-allowlisted field is rejected at execute time (raw API bypass closed)
preconditions: a stories entity where tenant_id/audit fields are NOT declared/allowlisted

test_cases.name: injection payloads are literal in both filter and search
preconditions: a stories entity (status filterable, title searchable + indexed tsvector)
expected_results: both match literally / zero rows; no SQL executed; no error leaking SQL

test_cases.name: search runs against the indexed tsvector column
preconditions: stories with distinctive title text; the tsvector migration applied
expected_results: matching stories returned via websearch_to_tsquery on the GIN-indexed column; %{results, meta}

test_cases.name: pagination capped; param cannot override tenant
preconditions: > max_page_size stories under tenant_t; rows under tenant_u
expected_results: result length <= max page size; meta.total_count reflects full count; scope stays tenant_t; tenant_u rows never returned

test_cases.name: stale entity def and no-tenant superadmin fail closed
preconditions: an entity declaring a field whose column was dropped; a superadmin key with nil tenant
expected_results: {:error, :stale_entity} (clean, no schema disclosure); superadmin/no-tenant /retrieve is refused (no cross-tenant read)

technical_notes: Module: Loopctl.ContextRetriever.Executor. Build queries via Ecto dynamic/2 with column atoms resolved from the validated allowlist (never String.to_atom on model input); pinned params only; no fragment with interpolation.

Full-text: add a migration creating GIN-indexed generated tsvector columns on stories/projects/epics for their searchable fields (there is NO reusable search_vector off articles); query with fragment("? @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', ?)", col, ^q). Do NOT use on-the-fly to_tsvector (seq scan DoS) or ILIKE.
Tenant: set RLS context (Repo.put_tenant_id / with_tenant) AND add the explicit predicate; isolation tests run as the non-owner app role (RLS ENABLE not FORCE — owner connection bypasses).
Audit: reuse the loopctl audit/chain-of-custody append path used elsewhere.
Return only declared fields (whitelist select), never select *.
Tests use Loopctl.Fixtures.fixture/2 with real story/project rows across two tenants, executed under the app role.
